flows.title: Share a video by email
steps: Open the video and select Share.

To share it inside your workspace, type the person's email address or search for their name, and choose whether they get view or edit access. The email they receive carries a thumbnail of the recording.
To share it outside, open the Social tab and select Share in Gmail, which embeds the video in the email. This works when the email address on your Loom account is your Gmail address.
Without Gmail, paste the video's URL into the email instead, or copy the GIF and embed that so the email shows a moving preview.
If automated summaries are on, the summary appears in the embed; delete that text by hand, or turn auto-summaries off in the video settings.

flows.title: Move a video into a space
steps: Only the owner of a video can move it between spaces.
In the upper-left corner of the video, select the menu and then Move.
Select the space, or one of its subfolders, and select Move again to carry the change out.
Confirm that the video should be unshared from its previous space. A video lives in one space at a time, and stays visible in your library wherever it sits.
A folder itself cannot be moved. Create a new folder in the space you want, then bulk-select the videos in the old folder and Move them across.
